title: Move Zeroes to End
description: Move all zeroes to the end of the array while maintaining the order of non-zero elements.

data.text: Given an array `nums`, move all `0`s to the end while preserving the order of non-zero elements. Do it in-place.
Collect non-zeros, then pad zeros at the end. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Extra Array O(n)
data.content: Collect non-zeros, then pad zeros at the end.

data.text: Track the position to place the next non-zero. Swap each non-zero into place. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Two-Pointer In-Place O(n)
data.content: Track the position to place the next non-zero and swap into place.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The two-pointer swap does the work in-place with a single pass.
